cases.study_information: Predict ofaschlupfer SC bioavailability as a fraction in Göttingen minipigs at 12 mg/kg SC relative to 12 mg/kg IV. Matched minipig IV exposure, monkey IV clearance and the bimagrumab reference are visible. Target SC AUC, Cmax and absorption parameters are withheld. Neither receptor affinity nor IV clearance uniquely determines absorption; interpret F using dose-normalized AUC.

dependence_note: Shared experimental family; count in original-family sensitivity aggregation, not as independent biological replication.
title: Predicting minipig subcutaneous bioavailability from a cross-route reference
